annotations.title: Update my Zero to Hundred draft

description: Update an owned draft. Omitted fields stay unchanged; nullable fields accept null to clear them. Live listings cannot be edited through this tool. Requires listings:write. Returns the draft identity and web edit/review links. On conflict, read the listing again before retrying.

askingPrice.description: Builder-confirmed USD license price. Null clears it; omission keeps it.

associatedListingIds.description: IDs of related listings owned by this Builder, obtained from z2h_list_my_listings.

demoUrl.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS demo URL. Null clears it; omission keeps it.

domains.description: Industry tags for the software. Choose keys from the Zero to Hundred taxonomy: ai, analytics, art-design, auth-identity, cms, conference, developer-tools, devops, e-commerce-marketplace, education, entertainment, environmental, fashion, finance, food, gaming, graphic-design, health, interior-design, marketing, membership, messaging, non-profit, political, productivity, real-estate, religious, services, social, technology, travel, ux-ui, wedding, other. Omission keeps the current tags.

externalDependencies.description: Third-party services a Buyer must provision. Common values: Supabase, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Upstash, Firebase, PlanetScale, Neon, Clerk, Auth0, Stripe, PayPal, Plaid, Resend, SendGrid, Postmark, Twilio, OpenAI, Anthropic.

cost.description: Expected service cost, such as USD 20/month.

name.description: Name of a service the Buyer needs to operate the software, such as Stripe.

note.description: What the software needs this service for.

faqs.description: Supplying FAQs disables the automatic FAQ draft.

question.description: Buyer question addressed by the paired answer.

imageUrls.description: HTTP or HTTPS screenshot URLs. The first image becomes the thumbnail.

longDescription.description: What the software does, who it helps, and what the Buyer receives.

mode.description: Non-exclusive license listing mode. Omit to keep it unchanged.

operatingStatus.description: Software readiness or commercial operating state, independent of listing publication. Omission keeps the current state.

shortDescription.description: Replacement summary for marketplace cards. Omission keeps the current summary.

slug.description: Listing slug returned by z2h_list_my_listings or z2h_create_draft_listing.

sourceCodeIncluded.description: Whether the sale includes source code, as confirmed by the Builder. Omission keeps the current choice.

sourceRepoUrl.description: GitHub repository URL. Null clears it; omission keeps it.

techStack.description: Frameworks and languages used by the software.

thumbnailUrl.description: HTTP or HTTPS thumbnail URL. Null clears it; omission keeps it.

title.description: Replacement name Buyers will see on the software listing. Omission keeps the current name.

type.description: Software category that best matches its main use.

videoUploadUrl.description: YouTube or Loom demo URL. Null clears it; omission keeps it.

name: z2h_update_draft_listing

createdAt.description: ISO creation timestamp, returned when creating a draft.

editUrl.description: Web wizard URL for editing this listing.

publishUrl.description: Web review step where the Builder finishes publishing.

slug.description: Listing identifier used by the other Builder tools.

status.description: Listing publication state. Only drafts can be edited through MCP.

termsAcceptance.description: Present when the Builder needs to accept terms before publishing.

acceptUrl.description: Website URL where the Builder accepts the terms.

required.description: The Builder must accept current terms in the website before publishing.
